messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — ran an FP8 enablement canary across H100 and L40S for redwood-1-7b (mixed-precision: FP8 kernels for matmuls, FP16 for layernorm/softmax). Short summary and weirdness below.

leo: awesome, what was the config?

anya: Command used: `./canary_run --model redwood-1-7b --precision fp8 --hw H100,L40S --kv-tiling auto --batch 8 --max-seq 4096 --canary-id fp8-hetero-1`

anya: Observations: 1) throughput +22% on H100, +18% on L40S for short seqs (<512). 2) On longer sequences (>=2048) we saw intermittent KV cache mismatch warnings and small quality deltas.

drew: mismatch warnings? logs?

anya: Snippet from runtime log:```
[WARN] kv_cache_checksum_mismatch seq=243 req_id=0x7f12 expected=0x3a8b got=0x3a9f module=kv_cache
[INFO] falling back to fp16 attention kernels for req_id=0x7f12
```

leo: falling back explains latency tail for those requests. Any pattern on which prompts fail?

anya: Yes — deterministic-ish: prompts that exercise repeated prefix cache hits (many small incremental tokens with long prefix) trigger it more. Also found activation clipping in a couple of eval prompts: token-level probability shifts (top-1 token changed) vs FP16 baseline.

Sophia: numbers for quality delta?

anya: Quick eval over 1k QA pairs: EM dropped 0.7% absolute (from 78.4 -> 77.7) on H100 FP8 canary. L40S similar ~0.9% drop. Most deltas concentrated on long-context reasoning prompts.

leo: Hmm small but real. Could be scaling exponent / dynamic range mismatch for some activations. Did you try increasing activation scale or disabling automatic exponent folding?

anya: Ran two micro-tests: 1) clamp_scale=1.1 -> EM recovered ~0.3% 2) disable_hetero_gemm for attention -> EM returned to baseline but throughput dropped ~12%.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary fp8-hetero-1 completed: 842/1000 successful, 158 had fallback/quality alerts.

drew: 158 is significant. Are those mostly fallback-to-fp16 events or genuine incorrect token outputs?

anya: Rough split 60/40 fallback vs quality-regression-only. Fallbacks correlate with KV checksum mismatches. Quality-only cases often show subtle logit reordering near low-confidence tokens.

leo: Could be tiling mismatch between matmul kernels and KV layout when hetero precision is used. Any tiling/stride params in the canary?

anya: We used runtime default: `tile=auto` with kernel selection heuristics. When I forced `tile=256x128` on H100 the KV checksum errors dropped by ~80% but throughput also fell.

Sophia: Action items?

anya: Proposed mitigations: 1) Add KV checksum validation in canary with auto-retry and targeted metric tagging (so infra can track). 2) Introduce a short canary that forces attention to fallback-to-fp16 only for long-seq traffic while keeping FP8 for short seqs (routing by seq len). 3) Experiment with slightly higher activation scaling/clamp for FP8 encode path (sweep +0.05 to +0.2). 4) Add a tile-size sweep on L40S (different optimal than H100).

leo: I can own tile-size sweep on L40S this week.

Sophia: I'll add the checksum+tagging to the telemetry dashboard and create alerts for >1% fallback rate per model.

drew: I'll prototype a seq-length routing policy in the serving layer (route seq>=2048 to fp16-attn). Shouldn't be too invasive.

anya: One more gotcha: GPT-style evals (sampling with temperature) amplified small logit shifts into visible output differences. Deterministic greedy tasks less impacted. Note for rollout: prefer canaries with sampling off or include both modes.

leo: Good call. Also add a small long-context eval set to the canary (100 examples specifically exercising repeated cache hits).

anya: Ok — next steps: Leo tile sweep (L40S), Drew seq-routing PR, Sophia telemetry tags/alert, I’ll run clamp scaling sweep + re-run canary. Planning to re-run mid-week and post updated numbers.

Sophia: :thumbsup: thanks.

infra-bot: Note: schedule next canary window Wed 03:00 UTC if changes land by Tue EOD.``
